sentences.text: Stephen -LRB- or Stephan -RRB- Gary Wozniak -LRB- -LSB- ˈwɒzniæk -RSB- , born August 11 , 1950 -RRB- , nicknamed `` Woz '' , is an American inventor , electronics engineer , programmer , philanthropist , and technology entrepreneur who co-founded Apple Inc. .	electronics engineer	electronics engineer	programmer	programmer	philanthropist	philanthropist	entrepreneur	entrepreneur

He is known as a pioneer of the personal computer revolution of the 1970s and 1980s , along with Apple co-founder Steve Jobs .	personal computer revolution	personal computer revolution	Steve Jobs	Steve Jobs	personal computer revolution of the 1970s and 1980s	Microcomputer revolution
Wozniak single-handedly developed the 1976 Apple I , which was the computer that launched Apple .	Apple I	Apple I

He primarily designed the 1977 Apple II , known as one of the first highly successful mass-produced microcomputers , while Jobs oversaw the development of its unusual case and Rod Holt developed the unique power supply .	Apple II	Apple II	Rod Holt	Rod Holt
